items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.beast_lord.des: Beastfolk that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Demi-Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.beastfolk.desc: A race that can freely change between their true animal form and a more a human form. They possess immense physical prowess and regenerative capabilities that let them fight without rest.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.daemon_lord.de: One of the most powerful evolutionary stages of daemons, achieved only by the most powerful arch daemons.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.death_oni.desc: Wicked Oni that has "evolved the correct way" and became a Spiritual Lifeform.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.demon_slime.de: The ultimate stage of evolution of Slimes. They evolve to this stage by awakening as a True Demon Lord during the Harvest Festival.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.race.devil_lord.des: The final stage of evolution for daemons. One emerges when a daemon meets all three requirements of a name, material body, and divinity.
